title: Car Key Programming
excerpt: Programming support for many modern vehicle keys, remotes, and fobs.
intro: Modern vehicles often need programming support after a key, remote, or fob replacement. Planetlocksmiths handles programming-related automotive key work across Philadelphia.

sections.heading: Vehicle details matter
sections.body: Make, model, year, and key type help determine what programming support is available.

sections.heading: Designed for mobile service
sections.body: Programming-related jobs are coordinated as part of the mobile automotive workflow whenever compatible.

faq.question: Do all keys need programming?
faq.answer: No. Many modern keys do, but the requirement depends on the vehicle and key type.

faq.question: Can you program key fobs?
faq.answer: Key fob support is part of the service offering for many vehicles.
